study type: prospective, population-based study and literature review
exposure: six potentially life-saving indications for caesarean section
cohort: 271,855 deliveries in six low- and middle-income countries (Argentina, Guatemala, Kenya, India, Pakistan, and Zambia) between 2010 and 2013
finding: A minimum overall caesarean section rate of 9% was needed to address the prevalence of six life-saving indications across the study sites.
country: Argentina, Guatemala, Kenya, India, Pakistan, and Zambia
